newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Money market rates play greater role in SNB policy.
newsitem.headline: Money market rates play greater role in SNB policy.

text.p: BERNE, June 19 (Reuter ) - Swiss National Bank board member Bruno Gehrig said short-term interest rates as reflected in Swiss money market operations have begun to play a greater role in the SNB's day-to-day monetary policy in the past year.
Asked whether money market rates had become a more important part of the SNB's policy, Gehrig said:
"That is quite clear. We began in August or in September to orient ourselves more strongly toward money market rates." he told reporters.
In late August the SNB started adding liquidity to counter upward pressure on the franc.
At the same time, he said, the aggregates were playing a less important role, at least in terms of day-to-day operations.
